description:
Children in Jamaica by age band, derived from the WorldPop "Jamaica 100m Age structures in 2020" constrained dataset (Bondarenko et al. 2020, DOI 10.5258/SOTON/WP00695) and the WorldPop 2020 constrained total population (DOI 10.5258/SOTON/WP00684). Five Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs (ages 0-4, 5-9, 10-14, 15-19 and 0-19 combined, one file each), a 1 km GeoParquet grid for spatial joins in DuckDB, and a parish-level table joined to the OCHA COD-AB parishes. All values are modelled 100 m population estimates for 2020 disaggregated from census projections and constrained to built settlements, not census counts. Source rasters retrieved from data.worldpop.org on 2026-09-23; derived by CARTO for the UNICEF Hurricane Melissa demo. CC BY 4.0.

**Disclaimer:** a demonstration of Portolan as cloud-native infrastructure for disseminating open geodatasets. This catalog republishes data from its original publishers in cloud-native formats such as GeoParquet and PMTiles, with STAC metadata — open, standards-based and freely accessible to everyone. It is not an official service of the original publishers, which remain the authoritative source.
